Conspiracy Theory or Structural Design?
The "Innocence" Theory
Assumes the rich and powerful who are
highly educated and possess immense
resources--blindly blunder through
history, unaware of their own interests,
while global policies randomly result in
their massive enrichment.
Structural Reality
Recognizes that the ruling class
consciously utilizes the State to maintain
its dominant socio-economic position,
employing secrecy, planning, and force
to ensure systematic wealth
accumulation.
Dismissing structural analysis as "conspiracy theory" is a defense mechanism. US
foreign policy isn't a series of "stupid blunders"-it is a rational, relentless enterprise.

A DREADFUL SUCCESS
- The U.S. Empire has not failed.
- It has successfully crushed alternative economic models worldwide.
- It has enriched the multinational corporate class beyond historical precedent.
- It has achieved this by parasitizing the wealth, labor, and moral soul of the
American Republic.
To oppose the Empire is not to oppose the Republic. True national
security means secure jobs, safe homes, and wresting power from the
military-industrial complex to return it to the people.
